# Pattaya Rent a Bike
> pattayarentabike.com

Motorbike and scooter rental in Pattaya since 2009, part of the Pattaya Rent a Car group. Yamaha and Honda automatic scooters, compulsory government insurance (Po Lo Bo) and two helmets included, unlimited mileage.

## Contact
- Phone/WhatsApp: +66 86 332 9077
- Email: info@pattayarentacar.com
- Line: @pattayarentacar

## Office
- Pratumnak Office, 359/119 Moo 12 Nongprue, Pattaya City, Chon Buri 20150
- Open 9am - 5pm, 365 days a year
- Pickup and return at this office only - no hotel delivery

## Fleet & Pricing (per day / per month, THB)
- Yamaha GT 125 (125cc, Auto): 200/day, 2,500/month
- Yamaha Nmax (155cc, Auto): 300/day, 4,000/month
- Honda PCX (150cc, Auto): 300/day, 4,000/month
- Yamaha Aerox (155cc, Auto): 300/day, 4,000/month

Prices are subject to change - confirm exact price and availability at time of booking.

## Rental Requirements
- Original passport and a valid driving licence shown at pickup - the passport is not kept
- 1,000 THB cash deposit required, refunded on return
- Compulsory government insurance (Po Lo Bo) included on all bikes. It covers basic medical costs only, not damage to the bike.
